    if not grid:

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    
    # Find bounding box of 8s (frame)

    min_c, max_c = w, -1
    obj_c = None  # track suspect "object" color

                if c > max_c: max_c = c
                obj_c = val
    
    if max_c == -1:
        return grid
    
    # Center of symmetry

    center_c = (min_c + max_c) / 2.0
